capabilities: insert time trackers into notes via a command
start and end named timed segments with buttons
persist tracking as timestamps in a JSON code block
expose a JavaScript API for reading tracker data
extras: Full API documentation is not yet written; the README points to the code, and support is offered through a Discord server.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track time spent on the work described in a note.

relations.evidence: provides daily and monthly statistics views across your whole vault based on your Super Simple Time Tracker data
Dataview and its JavaScript API DataviewJS can be used to access the Super Simple Time Tracker API

summary: Insertable time tracker code blocks for notes that record named start and end segments and keep running across restarts.
